{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch5tSnTgkYebRHE7kvpmG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I found and fixed three separate rendering bugs. Each one affects a different kind of object, which matches the report. The client rebuilds cleanly with `ninja`. I haven't run the game to compare against the video, and the recording's game isn't in the repo (only `devtest` is), so I worked out which object each bug affects from the code.\n\n1. **Fences, and any other node that connects to its neighbours** (`src/client/content_mapblock.cpp`, `drawNodeboxNode`). The table of directions used to find neighbours had \"front\" and \"back\" swapped: front pointed to +Z when it should be −Z. So a fence looking north and south for neighbours drew each rail on the opposite side. That's why the video shows rails sticking out sideways at the ends and gaps between posts. The server's own neighbour check in `mapnode.cpp` already uses −Z for front, so the client now matches it.\n\n2. **Leaves, and any other box-shaped node drawn larger or smaller than normal** (same file, `drawAutoLightedCuboid`). The node's world position was added *before* its size scaling was applied, so the scaling also stretched the position. Leaves (drawn larger than a block) ended up shifted away from where they were placed, and the shift grows the farther the node is from the world's centre. That's why the canopy sits off the trunk and the apples look like they're hanging in empty air. The apples themselves are in the right place. The fix applies the scaling first and then moves the node into position.\n\n3. **Turned 3D-model nodes** (`src/client/mesh.cpp`, `rotateMesh`). The angle conversion was backwards: it converted degrees using `radToDeg` instead of `degToRad`. So any model node that was turned, mounted on a wall, or given a fine-grained rotation was drawn at a wrong, essentially random angle. This applies to every turned model node, not just ones visible in the video.\n\nI also compared the other related code against how the engine is meant to work and found nothing else wrong: wall-mounted and turned box nodes, plants, torches, signs, rails, the server-side neighbour check, and the base rotation functions."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":365,"cache_read_input_tokens":69554,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":365,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":6,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"941b79d5-7c9f-473d-a26d-15bd6f532a95","uuid":"479fdca6-732e-483b-b060-a00ee41798dc","timestamp":"2026-11-16T03:21:31.788Z"}
